PR.name: Performance Rating
PR.summary: Combines pressure-adjusted baseline scoring/economy with clutch performance multipliers and Empirical Bayes credibility shrinkage toward tournament prior mean.

ERS.name: Evidence Reliability Score
ERS.summary: Multi-dimensional exposure metric capturing volume, clutch sample size, matches played, and tournament breadth through linear saturation functions.
ERS.benchmarks: Saturation caps: 120 clutch deliveries, 300 total deliveries, 25 matches, 3 competitions.
ERS.tiers: Strong Evidence: ERS >= 60.0 & Clutch >= 40 & Matches >= 10 | Moderate Evidence: ERS >= 35.0 & Clutch >= 20 & Matches >= 5 | Insufficient: Sample too small for primary ranking

SSS.name: Statistical Stability Score (Top-Tier Impact Retention Index)
SSS.summary: Calibrated Top-Tier Impact Retention Index evaluating candidate resilience across 1,000 bootstrap resamples, rank volatility (Top-20 retention frequency), match volume concentration (HHI), and leave-one-match-out (LOMO) rating shifts.
SSS.note: Specifically calibrated to measure a player's ability to retain elite top-tier impact across resampled tournament states without single-match sample dependency.

TFS.name: Tactical Squad Fit Score
TFS.summary: Measures direct alignment between player tactical role and Rajasthan Royals squad voids across retention scenarios, applying a 0.90x modifier to overseas players to reflect international roster limits.

ARS.name: Acquisition Risk Score
ARS.summary: Quantifies auction bidding inflation risk, overseas slot scarcity, statistical volatility, and historical availability constraints.
ARS.penalty: Includes a +6.0 risk penalty for overseas candidates.

RDH.name: Recruitment Decision Holistic Score
RDH.summary: Synthesizes performance, reliability, stability, and tactical fit while penalizing acquisition risk. Operates on a strict 0.00 to 90.00 theoretical scale because positive weights sum to 0.90.
RDH.critical_rule: Theoretical range is strictly [0.0, 90.0]. Never display RDH as a percentage or win probability.

candidate_governance_rules.description: Actionable recruitment recommendations for Rajasthan Royals. Availability unconfirmed pending official IPL 2027 auction player registration.

Pakistani players (e.g., Sufiyan Muqeem, Imad Wasim, Haris Rauf). Ineligible for IPL under long-standing regulatory policy. Displayed strictly as international analytical benchmarks, never as actionable auction recommendations.
Elite franchise cornerstones (e.g., Jasprit Bumrah, Suryakumar Yadav, Sunil Narine, Rinku Singh) highly likely to be retained by rival teams. Included for comparative performance benchmarking.
Veterans retired from IPL competition (e.g., Dinesh Karthik) serving as historical reference benchmarks.
Current Rajasthan Royals roster players (e.g., Dhruv Jurel, Ravindra Jadeja, Riyan Parag, Ravi Bishnoi, Yashasvi Jaiswal) evaluated as internal retention assets.

assumptions_register.description: Rajasthan Royals 2026 squad composition (27 registered players, 16 matches played)
assumptions_register.impact_on_model: Establishes baseline squad depth, role distribution, and performance baselines.

assumptions_register.description: IPL squad size limits (18-25 players) and overseas player cap (max 8 in squad, max 4 in playing XI)
assumptions_register.source: BCCI / IPL Governing Council Tournament Regulations
assumptions_register.impact_on_model: Hard constraints on recruitment pool selection and scenario squad building.

assumptions_register.description: Playing XI must include at least 1 verified wicketkeeper; squad must possess minimum 2 viable wicketkeepers
assumptions_register.impact_on_model: Evaluates Dhruv Jurel's wicketkeeper retention and backup keeper requirements.

assumptions_register.description: Official player retentions and releases for IPL 2027 have not been declared by BCCI as of late 2026
assumptions_register.source: Official BCCI / IPL Public Notice Audit
assumptions_register.impact_on_model: Mandates explicit retention scenario modeling (Scenarios A, B, C) rather than speculative assertions.

assumptions_register.description: Official remaining purse, base prices, and expected auction values for IPL 2027 are unpublished
assumptions_register.impact_on_model: Prohibits fabricated financial values; models auction strategy using 100 Budget Allocation Units / percentage shares.

assumptions_register.description: Player auction registration list for IPL 2027 is unpublished; historical candidates are evaluated conditionally on availability
assumptions_register.impact_on_model: Shortlists are labelled as recruitment targets subject to confirmed auction entry.
